name: Manitowish River
gaugeName: MANITOWISH RIVER NR CT HWY H NR BOULDER JCT. WI
blurb: Manitowish River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.routeReview: Use the signed carry to launch below Fishtrap Dam and take out above Highway K. The access-area map is available; no dotted path crosses a dam or portage.

notices.title: Start below Fishtrap Dam; finish above Highway K
notices.text: DNR’s paddling guide starts this trip below Fishtrap Dam, reached from the end of Dam Road. Carry to the signed downstream launch. Take out above the Highway K rapids. These markers show access areas, not the exact landing or portage trail. Check the guide and current signs before launching.

notices.title: Highway K and Rest Lake portages
notices.text: Start below the Highway K rapids using the signed carry from the access area. This trip also requires carrying around Rest Lake Dam at Highway W. Follow DNR’s paddling guide and current portage signs; do not paddle over the dam. The Benson Lake marker identifies an approximate access area.
